## About Tour Me Morocco

Tour Me Morocco is a private chauffeur and transport company based in Marrakech, Morocco.
We specialise in fixed-price private transfers, day excursions with local guide, and multi-day private circuits.
All services depart from Marrakech (or hotel pickup anywhere in the city).
Professional, multilingual drivers (French, English, Arabic, Italian).

Contact: WhatsApp +212 709 274 114
Website: https://tourmemorocco.com
Booking: WhatsApp message or online form — confirmed within 1 hour.

---

## Private Transfers (41 routes) — Fixed-Price Door-to-Door

No meter, no surprises. Confirmed by WhatsApp within 1 hour.
Vehicles: SUV 4×4 (Škoda Kodiaq, 1–4 pax) · Van Ford Tourneo (5–7 pax) · Luxury Van Mercedes Vito (5–7 pax)
All prices are per vehicle, not per person.

## Key Facts

- Company: Tour Me Morocco
- Location: Marrakech, Morocco (31.6295°N, 7.9811°W)
- Languages: French, English, Arabic, Italian
- Pricing model: Fixed price per vehicle (not per person)
- Payment: Cash or bank transfer — paid on the day
- Availability: 24h/7, 365 days/year
- Response time: WhatsApp booking confirmed within 1 hour
- Flight tracking: Yes, for all airport transfers (free)
- Child seat: Available on request at no extra charge
- WhatsApp: +212 709 274 114

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is the cheapest transfer from Marrakech airport to city centre?**
A: The transfer from Marrakech Menara Airport (RAK) to the city starts at €15 for an SUV 4×4.
URL: https://tourmemorocco.com/fr/transfers/aeroport-menara

**Q: How much is a private transfer from Marrakech to Casablanca?**
A: From €120 in SUV 4×4 (Škoda Kodiaq), €145 in Ford Tourneo van, €165 in Mercedes Vito luxury van.
URL: https://tourmemorocco.com/fr/transfers/casablanca

**Q: How much is a private transfer from Marrakech to Essaouira?**
A: From €105 in SUV 4×4. The trip is 176 km and takes about 2h30.
URL: https://tourmemorocco.com/fr/transfers/essaouira

**Q: How much is a private transfer from Marrakech to Merzouga (Sahara)?**
A: From €500 in SUV 4×4. The trip is 545 km and takes about 7h15.
URL: https://tourmemorocco.com/fr/transfers/merzouga-sahara

**Q: What excursions are available from Marrakech?**
A: 10 private excursions including Ourika Valley, Ouzoud Waterfalls, Agafay Desert, Imlil/Atlas, Aït Ben Haddou, Essaouira.
URL: https://tourmemorocco.com/fr/excursions

**Q: How do I book a transfer or excursion?**
A: Fill the form on the website or send a WhatsApp message to +212 709 274 114. Confirmed within 1 hour.

**Q: Are prices per person or per vehicle?**
A: All prices are per vehicle, not per person. A group of 4 pays the same as 1 person.

**Q: Do you offer airport transfer with flight tracking?**
A: Yes. We track your flight number and adjust pickup time in case of delay at no extra cost.
